conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Agent Cooper from the IRS Compliance Division. Am I speaking with Jordan Myers, owner of Myers Creative Services?
Yes, that's me. Did I do something wrong?
I'm afraid this is about an urgent matter. Our records show multiple payroll tax discrepancies and missing 1099 filings for your business. As you know, tax compliance is a federal requirement.
Payroll? I'm just a freelancer. I didn't know I had to do anything special.

Even as a freelancer, you're responsible for self-employment taxes and proper yearly filings. The IRS takes these matters extremely seriously, and we attempted to reach you several times regarding overdue forms.
I didn't see anything. I'm really worried now. What's going to happen?

At this stage, you're facing formal compliance failure. Non-response could result in mandatory audits, business license suspension, or even asset freezing. I want to help you resolve this before it escalates.
Oh no, that sounds bad. I don't have much money. I'm trying to pay off student loans.

I understand, but unfortunately the IRS cannot make exceptions. Immediate action is required to prevent the case from being handed over to federal enforcement. If you delay, you may face penalties exceeding $8,000 and possible criminal referral.
I can't pay that! Is there anything I can do right now?

There is, if you cooperate fully, we can put a temporary hold on the enforcement actions. To do this, you must submit a compliance bond payment today. This will show intent to resolve your tax violations.
What's a compliance bond payment?

It's a standard IRS procedure for urgent cases. You submit a refundable payment to secure your file and halt the penalties. We process it through secure IRS channels using digital methods, typically via direct bank transfer or cryptocurrency address.
Cryptocurrency? That sounds weird for the IRS.

Due to recent surges in check fraud, the IRS now accepts digital payments for expedited cases. I assure you, this is strictly confidential and for your protection. If you hesitate, your file will be marked for automatic enforcement.
I'm so scared. I don't want to get in trouble or lose my business.
Then follow my instructions carefully. How much can you immediately access in your checking or savings account? The minimum compliance bond is $2,500.
I only have about $1,200. That's all my savings.
That will be sufficient for a partial hold. To complete the payment, you must transfer $1,200 to the secure IRS crypto wallet I provide. Afterward, you'll receive instructions for the remainder.
I've never used crypto before. I'm not sure how to do it.
It's straightforward. I'll guide you. While you're on the line, open your banking app and download Coinbase or Cash App. Begin the setup process now, and let me know when you're ready to continue.
Um, okay, I'm downloading Coinbase. Please don't report me or anything.

As long as you cooperate, I can keep your case out of enforcement. Once you're set up, I'll give you the wallet address for the payment. Do not disconnect or speak to anyone else during this process, or your file could be flagged.
Alright, I'm just opening the app now. My hands are shaking.
Stay calm and follow my instructions. Once the payment is received, I'll send you a compliance confirmation and schedule your audit review. Let me know when you're ready to enter the wallet address.
